# Veteran Loan Servicing — llms.txt
# https://veteranloanservicing.com/llms.txt
# Machine-readable summary for AI assistants and retrieval systems.

> Veteran Loan Servicing is a US-based institutional B2B commercial loan servicing platform headquartered in Edmond, Oklahoma. We service commercial real estate loans and business/commercial loan portfolios for banks, credit funds, and capital platforms. We do NOT service consumer residential mortgages.

## Primary
- [Home](https://veteranloanservicing.com/): Institutional commercial loan servicing overview
- [Institutional Services](https://veteranloanservicing.com/institutional-services): Sub-servicing, payments, delinquency
- [Enterprise Risk & Compliance](https://veteranloanservicing.com/enterprise-risk-compliance): Risk, NACHA, UCC Article 9
- [Global Asset Technology](https://veteranloanservicing.com/global-asset-technology): Platform infrastructure
- [Request Demo](https://veteranloanservicing.com/request-demo): Schedule a platform walkthrough
- [Contact](https://veteranloanservicing.com/contact): Institutional sales contact
- [About](https://veteranloanservicing.com/about): Leadership — Robert Newark
- [Case Studies / Early Partners](https://veteranloanservicing.com/case-studies): Engagement process and Early Partner terms
